lessons.title: Balancing Chemical Equations
lessons.summary: Balance equations using conservation of atoms.

content_blocks.text: A chemical equation is balanced when each element has the same number of atoms on both sides. Change coefficients, never subscripts.
2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O has four hydrogen atoms and two oxygen atoms on each side.
Balancing follows the law of conservation of mass.

concepts.title: Conservation of mass
concepts.explanation: Atoms are rearranged in a reaction; they are not created or destroyed.

lessons.source_reference: NCERT Science Class X, Chapter 1, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.prompt: Which coefficient balances H₂ + O₂ → H₂O?
questions.explanation: Two water molecules require two hydrogen molecules and one oxygen molecule.

lessons.title: Photosynthesis: Making Food
lessons.summary: Trace how green plants make glucose using light energy.
learning_objectives: State the word equation for photosynthesis
Explain the role of chlorophyll and stomata

content_blocks.text: Green plants use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. Chlorophyll captures the light energy.
Leaves are the main photosynthetic organs; stomata enable gas exchange.

concepts.title: Photosynthesis
concepts.explanation: The process by which green plants synthesise food using light energy.

lessons.source_reference: NCERT Science Class X, Chapter 6, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.prompt: Why is chlorophyll essential for photosynthesis?
questions.answer: It absorbs light energy used to drive photosynthesis.
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll transfers captured light energy into the chemical process.
